name: Love You to Bits
source:
In Love You to Bits, follow the adventure of Layla, a girl who just made an entire AI on her own! How will her silly project evolve? What impact will it have on her friendships? That's for you to find out!

[From [url=https://sb007.itch.io/love-you-to-bits]Itch.io[/url]]
